title: Hanes Womens Comfort Fit Scrub Pants, Moisture-Wicking Healthcare Scrubs for Women, 3 Pockets
description: Hanes presents this scrub_pants designed for womens adult. Made from sturdy stretch fabric, it features moisture-wicking, odor control, and storage details with three pockets. Perfect for work.
aboutThisItem: HANES SCRUBS - Made for those who make a difference. Medical scrubs are appropriate for use in healthcare settings such as hospitals, doctor’s offices, and long-term care facilities.
STORAGE DETAILS - Scrub pants for women have two deep hand pockets and one roomy utility pocket for plenty of room to stow the essentials.
STRAIGHT-LEG STYLING - Scrub pants feature an adjustable drawstring, stay-put elastic waistband, and a straight-leg silhouette.
ATHLETIC FIT, 30" INSEAM - Elevated fabrics and an athletic fit deliver high-performing mobility. Available in a wide range of sizes, including plus size scrub pants up to 3XL. Inseam: 30"
MADE TO LAST - Sturdy stretch fabric is designed for lasting wash and wear needs.
STAY COOL & FEEL FRESH - Cool Comfort fabric wicks moisture from the skin, while odor control keeps you feeling fresh.
